title: Full Time Farm Worker Gentry AR
description:
Schedule: Monday to Friday 7 am to 3:30 pm AND WEEKENDS BASED ON ROTATION SCHEDULE

Salary: $19 per hour

JOB SUMMARY

The Farm Production Technician I is responsible for supporting smooth farm operations. The role will ensure the cleanliness and maintenance of farm facilities and oversee livestock production with a focus on optimal animal welfare throughout all stages of production. Fundamental to this role is understanding and promoting the Quality System, adhering to company policies and procedures, and actively supporting the company's principles and values.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES, FUNCTIONS, AND RESPONSIBILITIES

•Feed rabbits daily according to prescribed schedule.
•Ensure rabbits have constant access to food and water.
•Record mortality data on a daily basis.
•Identify sick or injured rabbits, and euthanize rabbits when necessary.
•Be aware and knowledgeable of surroundings at all times in order to identify potential issues.
•Prepare, place, and maintain nest boxes.
•Check ventilation and lighting systems to ensure proper function on a daily basis.
•Maintain USDA compliance.
•Conduct maintenance on rabbit houses, cages, and watering systems as needed.
•Follow strict schedules to maintain livestock production and facility cleanliness.
•Maintain high standards of animal welfare, and a clean, safe work environment.
•Utilize proper biosecurity standards when entering and exiting houses.
•Conduct an overall inspection and inspection of BRC rabbits.
•Participate in research trials or experiments.
•Weigh and transport rabbits.
•Responsible for creating daily records.
•Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) required to safely accomplish work tasks.
•Operate a tractor, mower, weed eater, and other equipment to maintain grounds.
•Responsible for informing management of potential process or documentation issues.
•Comply with Pel-Freez, United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS), and Occupational Safety and Health Administration policies and procedures, food safety standards, general safety, animal welfare, and good manufacturing practices.
•Exhibit exemplary attendance and punctuality.
•Perform other duties as requested.

Based on the essential duties listed above, this position is considered safety-sensitive and therefore all work must be performed following quality standards and established safety procedures.

EDUCATION & RELATED EXPERIENCE

•A high school diploma or GED equivalent is required.
•Bachelor's degree in animal science, animal husbandry, or a related major is required.
•Previous work experience in livestock production is preferred.
•Ability to pass a Fitness for Duty Test provided by the company.
•A valid driver's license and the ability to be covered under the Company's automobile insurance is required.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

•Knowledge and understanding of safety procedures and industry regulations and guidelines required by the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), and Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS).
•A basic knowledge of plumbing and electrical processes, procedures, and applications.
•Familiarity with animal health and welfare is preferred.
•An ability to be precise and thorough, ensuring that no small elements are overlooked, and maintain a high standard of accuracy in one's work.
•An individual capable of safely and efficiently operating company equipment and vehicles.
•A responsible, self-managed individual with the ability to remain attuned to assigned work tasks.
•Flexibility, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to work both independently and alongside all levels of internal management and staff.
•The ability to follow instructions, learn the production process, and complete production paperwork.
•The ability to communicate clearly and concisely both verbally and in writing.
•The ability to understand and comply with all company policies and procedures, and all applicable state and federal laws.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES AND INTERACTIONS WITH OTHERS

The Farm Production Technician I has no supervisory responsibilities. However, the role will be expected to frequently interact with co-workers, management, and the general public.

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

title: Production Progam Manager, Optics
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Optics Production Program Manager will support the Director of Optics Production play a critical role in scaling and sustaining production of precision optical assemblies for advanced defense systems. This role owns the execution rhythm across the internal and external value stream — driving tasking, coordination, and accountability to ensure production plans translate into delivered hardware. You will work closely with engineering, supply chain, quality, and production teams, both internally and with manufacturing partners, to keep complex optical production programs on track. The ideal candidate brings strong project management discipline, a working knowledge of optical supply chains and production, and the relentless follow-through needed to drive outcomes across multiple workstreams simultaneously.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Drive Accountability: Drive initiatives across the optical production value stream which are aligned with our production and growth objectives to enhance production efficiency, scalability, and cost effectiveness. Assign tasks, set deadlines, track completion, and hold internal teams and external vendors accountable for delivering on commitments. Run regular cadences to ensure follow-through.
  • Production Execution & Coordination: Track build schedules, monitor work-in-process, and support the Director of production through coordinating across teams to resolve blockers and maintain on track to the Operating plan.
  • Supplier Execution Management: Serve as the focal point between external optical suppliers and internal supply and production teams to orchestrate material flow, ensure delivery performance, action closure, and issue resolution. Track multi-tiered supplier schedules, manage expedites, escalate shortages, and drive vendors to meet production requirements.
  • Special Projects: Lead internal special projects as directed — production line moves, capacity expansion initiatives, vertical integration, new tooling or fixture introductions, process qualification efforts, and other cross-functional initiatives critical to scaling optical production.
  • Cross-Functional Program Coordination: Act as the connective tissue between engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and program leadership — ensuring that design changes, quality escapes, supplier issues, and capacity shifts are communicated and addressed with urgency.
  • Resource & Cost Management: Manage and oversee transactional material flow between multi-tiered supply, ensuring accurate cost accounting and price visibility in coordination with finance. Ensure appropriate allocation of materials, labor and equipment to meet production goals. Monitor project budgets, track progress and ensure we are continually focused on solving the largest problems to improve the bottom line
  • Metrics, Reporting & Risk Escalation: Maintain production dashboards tracking on-time delivery, open actions, supplier performance, and work order status. Proactively identify risks to production schedules and flag them early with proposed mitigations, ensuring transparency across programs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in production or operations program management, project management, or manufacturing coordination within optical assembly, precision manufacturing, or an adjacent industry — defense or aerospace experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of driving cross-functional action items to closure on time.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex schedules across internal manufacturing and external vendors, holding multiple parties accountable simultaneously.
  • Working knowledge of optical assembly processes, clean room environments, or precision electro-mechanical manufacturing.
  • Strong command of ERP/MRP systems for production scheduling and material planning; proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project).
  • Excellent communication, organization, and follow-through.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance.

$146,000—$194,000 USD

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. title: Vessel Lead
description:
It is the responsibility of this position to plan, coordinate, and manage the total output and throughput of the GasTech Vessel Department. This position ensures all tasks necessary to fabricate pressure containing vessel equipment are in accordance with ASME and/or ANSI Pressure Vessel Codes. The purpose of the position is to provide the highest level of vessel manufacturing leadership and technical excellence for all personnel performing vessel operations. This position is responsible for producing products within the time and man-hours allocated in the production schedule, and in accordance with GasTech Quality Requirements. It is the goal of the position to establish the GasTech Vessel Department as the most highly respected process equipment welding group in the industries, and for the clients, we serve.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • The responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
  • Adhere to all established company safety expectations and procedures.
  • Participate in safety audits and other types of leadership safety enforcement activities as required.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to provide a safe and injury/accident-free workplace as instructed.
  • Plan and organize the department workforce.
  • Job, space, tooling and equipment planning as required, to maximize throughput.
  • Establish root cause and corrective actions to eliminate Quality incidents.
  • Drive root cause closed loop corrective action initiatives.
  • Participate and lead closed loop corrective action sessions to reduce the cost of poor quality.
  • Must possess the ability to interact with staff, customers, and vendors in a diplomatic and professional. demeanor. Moderate level of customer contact is required.
  • Ensure proper welding consumables are purchased, available and adequately marked and stored.
  • Ensure personnel are properly qualified to GasTech Weld Procedure Specifications.
  • Perform supervisory functions for the Manufacturing Manager in his/her absence as needed.
  • Knowledgeable in all ASME and ANSI Code welding requirements as it pertains to this department.
  • Knowledgeable in all oxy-fuel, plasma cutting and arc-gouging operations.
  • Ensure personnel are “in-procedure” when welding, as required by customer order.
  • Ensure department-specific employee training programs are implemented and followed.
  • Provide job status and scheduling information to the Manufacturing Manager.
  • Ensure all team members practice proper, professional, and consistent housekeeping.
  • Prepare, stage, and control the job flow through the Department.
  • Identify maintenance requirements and ensure their completion on all shop equipment.
  • Must possess the ability to effectively communicate and interact professionally with Customers and Customer representatives.
  • Must possess the ability to speak in front of staff at various group meetings, including department. meetings, shop staff meetings, companywide meetings, etc.
  • Must possess the ability to communicate and effectively deal with all levels of staff.
  • Must be able to fit and weld a vessel part, as needed.

title: Business Administrator, MRO
description:

  • Support month-end close activities by reviewing open work orders, verifying documentation, and assisting with budget and financial reporting.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for customers regarding scheduling, billing inquiries, estimates, payments, and administrative requests.
  • Provide administrative support to the Maintenance Support team and perform other duties as assigned.

title: Customer Experience Team Manager - Korean Team (Based in Seoul)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Agoda’s Customer Support Team understands that travel can be an everchanging environment. That is why we provide in-person, real-time help around the clock and in 38 languages. No matter the issue, we present the best of Agoda’s values to each and every customer with multiple support channels and a strong desire to serve. Certainly doing more than answering phone calls or replying to emails, our specialists actively look for ways to improve our customer’s experience. We quickly adapt to challenges by collaborating with other teams and experimenting on everything we can. This has allowed us to develop new and effective products that produce meaningful results and continue to drive Agoda’s business performance. Our Customer Support Team serves a daily role in contributing to a core strength and service of Agoda with a clear vision and a focus on efficient and satisfying customer support.

The Opportunity:

Are you passionate about travel and about people? Do you enjoy interacting with people as well as utilizing technology?

We are looking for a talented, energetic, results-oriented person who loves working in a fast-paced, multinational environment. As a Contact Center Team Manager based in Seoul, you will support both determined business objectives (KPIs) as well as acting as a motivator and decision maker to ensure that the group is working efficiently and in unity.

In this position, you will work closely with the operations management team and other departments within Agoda Customer Experience Group (CEG) to support our contact center. The team manager of operations will provide directions, instructions and guidance to the customer care specialists to achieve a certain goal. Understand the team members’ strengths, weaknesses and motivations.

The position requires you to provide extensive coaching to our contact center agents as well as provide valuable input on processes to our operations team.

You will also be expected to contribute with ideas for continuous organizational and employee skills development but also at the global level impacting our international contact center network.

In this Role, you'll get to:

  • Lead a team of approximately 15 contact center agents in an inbound contact center setup.
  • Continuously monitor the traffic & highlight discrepancies and take actions on spot if needed to ensure that service levels are met.
  • Provide constructive feedback - Coach, mentor, motivate and evaluate the performance of the team on a regular basis.
  • Identify performance gaps, formulate action plans to address identified gaps, implement and monitor action plans to ensure success.
  • Ensure the proper and effective implementation of new and existing customer service structures & procedures
  • Understand & analyze multi channel traffic reports, proactively make suggestions for improvement
  • Monitor team attendance, document infractions and implement corrective action
  • Assist with planning/organizing the proper coverage & align staffing
  • Supervise the quality assurance process and related training of staff members to ensure quality customer service.
  • Participate in recruitment activities (screening, interviewing)
  • Act as a backup of Regional Manager if needed

What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • At least 2 years of people management experience in a contact center environment.
  • Excellent English & Korean communication skills (verbal & written).
  • Able to work on 24/7 rotating shifts as per business requirements including on public holidays, and weekends as applicable.
  • Proven track record in evaluating, analyzing, implementing, leading, and monitoring processes to enhance contact center efficiency and staff performance.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and abilities in building partnerships with other departments and interacting with diverse individuals.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and effectively manage timelines.
  • Experience in hiring, training, coaching and people management practices.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft products including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Experience in managing stakeholder is a plus.
  • Experience in managing remote teams is an advantage

What we offer:

  • A highly diverse, multicultural work environment
  • Flexible Hybrid Work Model (with a one-time WFH allowance)
  • A compensation package, including benefits and performance-linked bonus, that is competitive for the role and aligned with country and industry standards.

title: Lead Materials Coordinator, Test Sites
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Lead Materials Coordinator, you will join our Deployment Operations team supporting one of Anduril's Test Sites. Test Sites are where our products meet the real world: dynamic, resource-constrained environments where rapid iteration, range operations, and customer demonstrations all happen. You will run with smaller teams and broader scope than production warehouses, which means the work is hands-on and the impact is immediate. The ideal candidate is an adaptable, proactive problem-solver who manages inventory and material operations under strict quality standards

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Process shipping, receiving, and inventory management at the Fort Stockton, TX test site
  • Coordinate and prepare inbound, outbound, and round-trip shipments moving between the test site, Anduril production facilities, and customer locations, including packaging, crating, labeling, and shipping documentation
  • Create and track shipment tickets in Jira, and coordinate delivery and pickup windows with carriers, drivers, and site security
  • Distribute received material to the correct team, lab, or individual on site, and track empty cases and non-inventory items back to their point of origin
  • Maintain inventory by identifying, labeling, and organizing materials and supplies, including bin locations and storage areas, and maintaining physical and digital records
  • Monitor inventory levels to identify anticipated material shortages and restock points, and raise them to site and Deployment Operations leadership
  • Pull, kit, pack, crate, label, and stage materials for test events, builds, and outbound shipments, ensuring product is properly secured and documented
  • Execute receiving, issuing, transfer order, and cycle-count transactions in Oracle and Odoo, including project striping and de-striping, and troubleshoot transfer order validation errors so material can move on schedule
  • Reconcile inventory records between systems when the physical count, Odoo, and Oracle disagree, escalating to Deployment Operations when a discrepancy cannot be resolved on site
  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other machinery to move items, or signal machine operators to move materials onto and off trucks and loading docks
  • Transport material between the test site and nearby Anduril or partner locations as needed
  • Expedite flow of material, parts, and assemblies within the site and between Anduril locations in accordance with test and operational schedules

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years as a materials coordinator, warehouse associate, or equivalent role
  • 2+ years of experience leading a team, training and mentoring employees for development
  • Knowledge of standard inventory management practices
  • Familiarity with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and/or other warehouse management and inventory control tooling
  • Ability to work proficiently and stay organized across multiple connected systems (ERP, Jira, Slack)
  • Ability to lift and move material, operate material handling equipment, and work on your feet in an active test environment
  • Ability to work onsite at the Test Site five days per week with occasional after-hours or weekend surge support as test and operational schedules dictate
  • Ability to travel to Anduril Headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA and other Anduril sites on occasion, no more than 20% travel
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of forklift experience and license
  • Experience supporting field operations, test ranges, or remote / austere sites
  • Experience working in the defense/aerospace industry
  • Proficient with spreadsheets for inventory reconciliation, reporting, and ad-hoc analysis
  • Familiarity with inventory management through lot, serial, or batch tracking
  • Experience packaging and handling hazardous shipments
  • Able to operate independently and prioritize tasks effectively in fast-paced environments
  • Comfortable working directly with engineers and technicians in an active test environment
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. clearance
US Hourly Range
$35—$47 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. title: Senior Materials Coordinator, Test Sites
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Materials Coordinator, you will join our Deployment Operations team supporting one of Anduril's Test Sites. Test Sites are where our products meet the real world: dynamic, resource-constrained environments where rapid iteration, range operations, and customer demonstrations all happen. You will run with smaller teams and broader scope than production warehouses, which means the work is hands-on and the impact is immediate. The ideal candidate is an adaptable, proactive problem-solver who manages inventory and material operations under strict quality standards

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Process shipping, receiving, and inventory management at the Fort Stockton, TX test site

  • Distribute received material to the correct team, lab, or individual on site, and track empty cases and non-inventory items back to their point of origin

  • Monitor inventory levels to identify anticipated material shortages and restock points, and raise them to site and Deployment Operations leadership

  • Execute receiving, issuing, transfer order, and cycle-count transactions in Oracle and Odoo, including project striping and de-striping, and troubleshoot transfer order validation errors so material can move on schedule
  • Reconcile inventory records between systems when the physical count, Odoo, and Oracle disagree, escalating to Deployment Operations when a discrepancy cannot be resolved on site
  • Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other machinery to move items, or signal machine operators to move materials onto and off trucks and loading docks
  • Transport material between the test site and nearby Anduril or partner locations as needed
  • Expedite flow of material, parts, and assemblies within the site and between Anduril locations in accordance with test and operational schedules

  • 5+ years as a materials coordinator, warehouse associate, or equivalent role
  • Knowledge of standard inventory management practices
  • Familiarity with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and/or other warehouse management and inventory control tooling
  • Ability to work proficiently and stay organized across multiple connected systems (ERP, Jira, Slack)
  • Ability to lift and move material, operate material handling equipment, and work on your feet in an active test environment
  • Ability to work onsite at the Test Site five days per week with occasional after-hours or weekend surge support as test and operational schedules dictate
  • Ability to travel to Anduril Headquarters in Costa Mesa, CA and other Anduril sites on occasion, no more than 20% travel
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance

  • 1+ years of forklift experience and license
  • Experience supporting field operations, test ranges, or remote / austere sites
  • Experience working in the defense/aerospace industry
  • Proficient with spreadsheets for inventory reconciliation, reporting, and ad-hoc analysis
  • Familiarity with inventory management through lot, serial, or batch tracking

title: Database Administrator
description:
Position Overview

The Database Administrator is a highly skilled technical role responsible for the performance, availability, security and reliability of enterprise database systems supporting critical business operations. This role includes Microsoft SQL Server database administration, performance monitoring and tuning, migrations, lifecycle management, high availability, disaster recovery and advanced troubleshooting. The DBA will provide technical leadership, act as the final escalation point for complex database issues and collaborate across teams to architect and deliver scalable, secure and reliable database solutions.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Provide technical leadership on database systems and solutions and act as the final technical escalation point for all database-related issues.
  • Manage, maintain, implement and support Microsoft SQL Server databases in a high-availability environment hosted in the cloud (SQL on VMs), using Always-On Availability Groups, mirroring and replication.
  • Plan and execute SQL Server upgrades, migrations and lifecycle management initiatives.
  • Perform database capacity planning, storage forecasting and resource utilization analysis.
  • Conduct research, analysis, monitoring and profiling to improve database performance, functionality, recoverability and availability.
  • Ensure data integrity, quality and security across all database systems.
  • Participate in the Disaster Recovery Planning and Testing to manage and validate backup, restore and recovery strategies and perform regular recovery testing to ensure recoverability of business-critical databases.
  • Architect and maintain databases for optimal performance and scalability.
  • Manage database maintenance activities including index optimization, statistics maintenance and SQL Agent job management.
  • Deploy and maintain database security controls and support security initiatives and audits.
  • Cross-train peers and team members and provide guidance on complex database issues.
  • Set and maintain high standards and best practices for database systems while refining, automating and documenting DBA processes through diagrams, SOPs and scripts.
  • Manage and tune database monitoring systems.
  • Participate in on-call rotation supporting business-critical systems.
  • Participate in development code reviews to educate on SQL coding standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with developers, BI, management and other IT staff to ensure database system reliability, performance and provide solutions to complex data challenges.
  • Evaluate, test, and recommend new technologies and tools.

Basic Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Fully Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience administering enterprise production database environments.
  • Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical production environments.
  • Expertise in Microsoft SQL Server including Always On, replication, mirroring and performance tuning.
  • Advanced troubleshooting and performance tuning experience including execution plans, indexing strategies, wait statistics and query optimization.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud services and experience managing databases in virtual machines within Azure.
  • Knowledge of database monitoring tools.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to mentor other team members.
  • Familiarity with database security best practices, high availability and disaster recovery.
  • Understanding of ETL vs ELT concepts.
  • Understanding of OLTP vs OLAP, BI tools and their integration with databases.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in relational database administration including MS SQL Server, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure SQL Database.
  • Experience with PowerShell or other scripting languages.
  • Experience with database migration to Azure SQL.
  • Experience in architecting databases for near real-time reporting.
  • Experience with database automation, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience using source control systems such as Git.
  • Experience with enterprise database monitoring platforms such as Redgate, Dynatrace, SolarWinds.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining NoSQL database technologies such as CosmosDB.
  • Relevant Certifications.

title: Customer Experience Team Manager - Japanese Team (Based in Yokohama)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Agoda’s Customer Support Team understands that travel can be an everchanging environment. That is why we provide in-person, real-time help around the clock and in 38 languages. No matter the issue, we present the best of Agoda’s values to each and every customer with multiple support channels and a strong desire to serve. Certainly doing more than answering phone calls or replying to emails, our specialists actively look for ways to improve our customer’s experience. We quickly adapt to challenges by collaborating with other teams and experimenting on everything we can. This has allowed us to develop new and effective products that produce meaningful results and continue to drive Agoda’s business performance. Our Customer Support Team serves a daily role in contributing to a core strength and service of Agoda with a clear vision and a focus on efficient and satisfying customer support.

The Opportunity:

Are you passionate about travel and about people? Do you enjoy interacting with people as well as utilizing technology?

We are looking for a talented, energetic, results-oriented person who loves working in a fast-paced, multinational environment. As a Contact Center Team Manager based in Yokohama, you will support both determined business objectives (KPIs) as well as acting as a motivator and decision maker to ensure that the group is working efficiently and in unity.

In this position, you will work closely with the operations management team and other departments within Agoda Customer Experience Group (CEG) to support our contact center. The team manager of operations will provide directions, instructions and guidance to the customer care specialists to achieve a certain goal. Understand the team members’ strengths, weaknesses and motivations.

The position requires you to provide extensive coaching to our contact center agents as well as provide valuable input on processes to our operations team.

You will also be expected to contribute with ideas for continuous organizational and employee skills development but also at the global level impacting our international contact center network.

In this Role, you'll get to:

  • Lead a team of approximately 15 contact center agents in an inbound contact center setup.
  • Continuously monitor the traffic & highlight discrepancies and take actions on spot if needed to ensure that service levels are met.
  • Provide constructive feedback - Coach, mentor, motivate and evaluate the performance of the team on a regular basis.
  • Identify performance gaps, formulate action plans to address identified gaps, implement and monitor action plans to ensure success.
  • Ensure the proper and effective implementation of new and existing customer service structures & procedures
  • Understand & analyze traffic reports, proactively make suggestions for improvement
  • Monitor team attendance, document infractions and implement corrective action
  • Assist with planning/organizing the proper coverage & align staffing
  • Supervise the quality assurance process and related training of staff members to ensure quality customer service.
  • Participate in recruitment activities (screening, interviewing)
  • Act as a backup of Regional Manager if needed

What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • At least 2 years of people management experience in a contact center environment.
  • Excellent English & Japanese communication skills (verbal & written).
  • Able to work on 24/7 rotating shifts as per business requirements including on public holidays, and weekends as applicable.
  • Proven track record of evaluating, analyzing, implementing, leading, and monitoring processes to enhance contact center efficiency and staff performance.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and abilities in building partnerships with other departments and interacting with diverse individuals.
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and effectively manage timelines.
  • Experience in hiring, training, coaching and people management practices.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft products including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience in managing stakeholder is a plus.
  • Experience in managing remote teams is an advantage

What we offer:

  • A highly diverse, multicultural work environment
  • Flexible Hybrid Work Model (with a one-time WFH allowance)
  • A compensation package, including benefits and performance-linked bonus, that is competitive for the role and aligned with country and industry standards.
  • Agoda staff discount on bookings
  • Career development opportunities
  • Supplemental medical & life insurance
  • Employee well-being programs

title: HR and Compliance Intern
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

Are you a college student looking to turn your classroom knowledge into real-world experience? At Perigon, our paid Summer Internship Program gives you a front-row seat to human resources, compliance, and the wealth management industry. You won’t be sitting on the sidelines—you’ll work alongside experienced professionals, contribute to meaningful projects, and gain a firsthand look at how an independent wealth management firm supports its employees, maintains regulatory compliance, and delivers exceptional outcomes for its clients.

At Perigon, we believe the best way to learn is by getting involved. Our internship is built around hands-on experiences, cross-functional exposure, mentorship, and opportunities to engage with professionals across the firm. You’ll build practical skills in HR operations, employee engagement, compliance practices, and regulatory procedures while gaining a deeper understanding of how human resources and compliance support a successful RIA. By the end of the summer, you’ll have expanded your professional network, strengthened your skill set, and gained a clearer picture of where your career could take you.


COMPANY OVERVIEW

Perigon Wealth Management is an independent RIA founded and led by lifelong advisors. With approximately $12.1 billion in AUM, we serve clients nationwide by combining the depth of a larger firm with the feel of a boutique, while supporting advisors who want to grow without giving up independence.


PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS


Duration: 10 weeks starting June 7th, 2027

Compensation: Paid

Schedule: Up to 30 Hours per Week

Location: Remote


EXPERIENCE

  • Comprehensive Onboarding:

Start the summer with a deep dive into Perigon’s mission, values, business, and commitment to serving clients. You’ll learn how the pieces of a wealth management firm fit together and how each team contributes to the client’s experience.

  • Department Rotations:

Go beyond the textbook and explore the teams that make a wealth management firm successful. Gain exposure to: Financial Planning, Investment Research, Client Services, Operations, Compliance, People & Culture, and Marketing & Business Development

  • Capstone Project:

Put your skills into action by completing a meaningful capstone project over the final 8 weeks. You’ll research a business opportunity or challenge, develop thoughtful recommendations, and present your findings to firm leadership—giving you experience that mirrors the work of professionals in the industry.

  • Mentorship & Networking:

Build relationships with mentors and professionals across Perigon. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions, learn from different career paths, and connect with team members at all levels of the organization.


We’re looking for more than a strong resume—we’re looking for people who are curious, driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact. The best Perigon interns bring a roll-up-your-sleeves attitude and are willing to jump in, ask questions, and take ownership. You should be excited to learn how a business works from the inside out and comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone.

Currently enrolled in a college or university (Finance, Business, Economics, or related majors preferred)

Targeting rising seniors, but must be a junior, senior, or postgraduate

GPA Requirement: 3.0

Genuine interest in wealth management, financial planning, investing, and client experience

A roll-up-your-sleeves attitude—willing to jump in, take initiative, and help wherever needed

Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with an interest in client engagement and collaborating with others

Team-oriented approach—you collaborate generously and are willing to roll up your sleeves to support the broader team

Professionalism and adaptability - bring energy, maturity, and a positive attitude to a changing environment

Ownership and follow-through - you can take a project from an assignment through completion

Curiosity and coachability, you ask thoughtful questions, seek feedback, and are eager to learn

description:
Business Systems Analyst 3 (MES, 42Q & ERP Specialist)

Location: Tlajomulco de Zúñiga, Jalisco (Near the Airport)

Work Modality: 100% On-site

Mandatory Requirement: Resume must be submitted in ENGLISH.

General Job Description

"Sanmina Empresa Transnacional, líder en la manufactura electrónica está comprometida con la promoción y acción a favor de la igualdad de oportunidades entre hombres y mujeres con o sin discapacidad o en alguna situación de vulnerabilidad o no; promoviendo la NO discriminación durante todo nuestro actuar y teniendo las mismas oportunidades de ingreso, desarrollo y permanencia en el empleo."


We are seeking a proactive Business Systems Analyst 3 to join our Global Business Services team. In this role, you will analyze complex business problems, configure technical system settings, and optimize automated solutions for manufacturing, logistics, and supply chain operations. You will act as a key technical liaison for traceability systems, ERP environments, B2B exchanges, and network troubleshooting across the facility.

Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Professional Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of proven experience in IT operations, specifically supporting Networks, Traceability systems (such as 42Q), and ERP environments.
  • Industry Background: Previous professional exposure to Manufacturing, Supply Chain, or Logistics environments is mandatory.
  • Project Exposure: Experience supporting system deployments, B2B data exchanges, and cross-departmental IT troubleshooting.
  • Language: English B1-B2 (Intermediate to Upper-Intermediate), fully capable of technical communication, report writing, and international alignment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Business & Systems Analysis: Identify, evaluate, and develop cost-effective automated systems and procedures that meet user and operational requirements.
  • Configuration & Testing: Configure system settings and options, plan and execute unit, integration, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and write detailed system specifications.
  • B2B & Network Support: Support B2B data exchanges (EDI & API) and troubleshoot cross-departmental IT network issues impacting production or warehouse flows.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead linked teams to address business or systems issues, acting as an internal consultant for automated solutions.
  • End-User Consultation: Partner with warehouse and supply chain teams, translating complex IT concepts into clear operational guidance.

Technical Knowledge & Skills:

  • Traceability & MES: Solid hands-on knowledge of 42Q tools or equivalent Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
  • Processes: Strong familiarity with Discrete Order Fulfillment (DOF) processes and system configurations.
  • Data Exchanges: Troubleshooting experience with EDI and API B2B transactions.
  • Networking & Tools: Understanding of IT network terms, network diagrams, MS Office, and Google Workspace.
  • Competencies: Strong accountability, proactive problem-solving to prevent bottlenecks, and a continuous learning mindset.

Compensation & Benefits Package (Above the Law):

  • Direct hiring by Sanmina with an indefinite contract.
  • Weekly Payroll (Every Friday).
  • 13% Savings Fund & 8% Monthly Grocery Vouchers (Both with legal cap).
  • 27 days of Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo).
  • Profit Sharing Guarantee: 3 weeks of nominal salary as a guaranteed bonus (paid to active employees on the distribution date, or proportional part).
  • Gasoline Allowance: $434.00 MXN monthly (for degreed professionals or supervisor positions and above).
  • Vacations: 12 days for the first year + 50% Vacation Premium.
  • Major Medical Insurance (SGMM): Comprehensive coverage for you and your direct dependents (includes a 5-year coverage extension policy for active dependents under 25 in case of employee passing).
  • Life Insurance: Coverage equivalent to 36 months of salary.
  • Company Shuttle / Transportation: Over 60 routes covering the Guadalajara Metropolitan Area (ZMG).
  • Subsidized On-site Cafeteria & access to Sanmina's On-site Integration Center (CIS).
  • Special Paid Time Off: Birthday off + December 24th and 31st granted as paid company holidays.
  • Educational Perks: Potential for English language and university scholarships.

Apply Today!

If you are an IT professional with deep experience in manufacturing execution systems, ERPs, and B2B tracking, apply today by submitting your Resume in ENGLISH through this platform.

title: District Partnership Specialist, New England (Boston)
description:
IXL Learning, a global edtech leader with personalized learning products used by millions of students worldwide, is seeking a District Partnership Specialist to join our Professional Learning team and support districts in New England.

At IXL, we seek to help districts transform teaching and learning through best-in-class technology and services. As a District Partnership Specialist, you’ll serve as a trusted consultant, guiding school districts in New England through every stage of their implementation. You’ll ensure each district has a clear plan for using IXL tailored to their district goals and initiatives. In addition to delivering professional development, you’ll meet regularly with district and school leaders to monitor progress, analyze data, and plan next steps. You’ll work closely with internal teams to identify opportunities to expand district partnerships and share insights that help shape our products and services. #LI-REMOTE

We are looking for an enthusiastic, highly organized, and strategic educational leader with school or district leadership experience who thrives in a collaborative, high-energy environment. The ideal candidate is a polished communicator and engaging presenter who is energized by being in schools and classrooms, building relationships, and supporting educators in the field. #LI-BOSTON

This is a full-time remote position for candidates living in Boston, Massachusetts.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Serve as an IXL implementation expert, supporting large, complex districts with their IXL implementation
  • Partner with district leaders throughout New England to create and implement a professional development plan that supports a successful IXL implementation aligned to their goals and initiatives
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders across districts, including district leaders, principals, and teachers, to ensure a consistent implementation
  • Travel in New England to deliver professional development, meet with district and school leaders, visit classrooms, and provide other hands-on implementation support— 40% - 60% local travel with occasional overnight travel
  • Partner with the Sales team to effectively manage and grow customer relationships, including supporting districts piloting IXL and other pre-sales opportunities
  • Deliver high-quality live and virtual professional development sessions to drive engagement and usage of IXL
  • Analyze and use data to drive decision-making and strategize next steps

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • BA/BS degree
  • Experience as a K-12 educator, with 5+ years of experience delivering professional development in K-12 settings
  • MUST either have experience as a school or district administrator OR have extensive experience delivering PD to these audiences
  • Experience leading a district or school instructional initiative or curriculum adoption
  • An analytical, strategic thinker who can interpret data and develop effective plans that drive implementation
  • Exceptional presentation skills; comfortable presenting to teachers and administrators
  • Excellent interpersonal skills—dynamic, enthusiastic, upbeat individual who connects well with others and has a positive, collaborative attitude
  • Organized, methodical, and detail-oriented; ability to prioritize and effectively manage multiple projects and tasks concurrently, from start to finish
  • Self-starter and quick learner with a passion for improving education through technology

The base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 to $105,000 + potential bonus eligibility + benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire pay for the position. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

ABOUT IXL LEARNING

IXL Learning is the country's largest EdTech company. We reach millions of learners through our diverse range of products. For example:

  • 1 in 4 students in the United States uses
  • Rosetta Stone provides an immersive learning experience for 25 languages
  • Wyzant is the nation's largest community of tutors, covering 300+ subjects
  • Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT) is a comprehensive marketplace for millions of educator-created resources

Our mission is to create innovative products that will make a real, positive difference for learners and educators and we're looking for passionate, mission-minded people to join us in achieving this goal. We have a unique culture at IXL that fosters collaboration and the open exchange of ideas. We value our team and treat one another with kindness and respect. We approach our work with passion, tenacity, and authenticity. We find it immensely satisfying to develop products that impact the lives of millions and we are eager to have you join our team.

title: Senior Solutions Architect - Japan
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted advisor to GitLab customers and prospects in Japan. You'll explain how GitLab's artificial intelligence-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform addresses customers' business priorities and technical requirements, helping technical leaders and executives evaluate its value.

You'll translate technology into business value and help customers make informed adoption decisions. The initial sale isn't the end of the relationship: you'll support continued adoption, new use cases, and expansion into additional products and editions, helping increase GitLab consumption through greater customer value.

What you’ll do

  • Lead structured discovery to understand customer business priorities, development processes, challenges, stakeholders, and success criteria. Connect proposed solutions to business value and return on investment.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives on account strategies and customer action plans that move opportunities from technical evaluation to contract.
  • Lead demos, workshops, proofs of concept or value, architecture design, and technical validation, including Linux-based, self-managed, and air-gapped customer environments.
  • Design roadmaps for DevSecOps and artificial intelligence-enabled development across the software development lifecycle. Address processes, roles, governance, and developer experience. Plan the effort and timelines for migrating continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines from Jenkins to GitLab.
  • Resolve post-sale adoption challenges with post-sales teams and partners, and identify expansion opportunities across use cases, business units, workloads, products, and editions.
  • Build relationships with developers and business and technical leaders. Explain GitLab's competitive differentiation and address objections about existing tools, overlapping artificial intelligence capabilities, cost, and migration effort.
  • Create reusable proposals, architecture diagrams, proof-of-value plans, executive materials, technical content, and success stories. Present at webinars and marketing events to support pipeline development.
  • Share customer feedback and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. Test GitLab, artificial intelligence, DevSecOps, and cloud technologies hands-on, and mentor team members to share best practices.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, technical sales, or a similar customer-facing role, using structured discovery, value selling, stakeholder mapping, and consensus building.
  • Practical understanding of the software development lifecycle, DevSecOps, security, and cloud technologies, with experience using GitLab or comparable source control, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and developer collaboration platforms.
  • Experience leading demos, workshops, proofs of concept or value, technical proposals, or solution architecture design, and the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations with customer technical teams.
  • The ability to explain technical trade-offs and business value to developers, technical leaders, and executives, and collaborate with Account Executives on opportunity strategy, adoption, and expansion.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation and Model Context Protocol, and the ability to discuss their use in artificial intelligence-enabled development.
  • The ability to mentor team members, share reusable knowledge, and give and receive feedback with empathy and respect for others' expertise.
  • Fluency in Japanese and professional working proficiency in English.
  • Helpful but not required: a background in software development, systems integration, or project or product management. Other useful experience includes developer productivity, cloud-native technologies, enterprise platform governance and rollout, post-sales recommendations, consumption-based models, or creating reusable technical content.

About the team

The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization. We work with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, post-sales teams, and partners across regions, collaborating asynchronously to share reusable knowledge and best practices. We learn through hands-on testing and iteration, guided by GitLab's values of collaboration, customer results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

title: Finance Process Manager — Billing & Collections
description:
Company Overview

The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.

MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.

What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.

Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.

Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.

Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.

Position Overview:

This role exists to put a single accountable owner over the customer-facing finance lanes — Billing, Collections and Discounts. Today those lanes are run under a shared model where execution and ownership sit with different people, which makes it difficult to hold any one person accountable for outcomes.

Success in this role means billing is accurate the first time, collections convert billed revenue to cash predictably, and the offshore team executing that work is managed to a clear standard. This is an ownership and oversight role rather than a processing role: the day-to-day execution sits with the Philippines team, and this position is accountable for the result.

The seat calls for a senior accounting skillset applied to the order-to-cash cycle. The person in it designs the process, sets the controls, and uses technology and an offshore team to deliver at high volume.

As the Finance Process Manager — Billing & Collections, you will report to the Controller and oversee a Philippines-based team, with some oversight shared with the other Finance Process Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the billing function end to end across all product lines — accuracy, completeness and timeliness
  • Own the collections process, from proactive client outreach through to escalation, recovery and write-off
  • Manage the discount and service adjustment approval process, holding approval authority and facilitating escalations across departments
  • Lead and develop the Philippines-based team executing this work day to day — set standards, review output, approve work and run the review rhythm
  • Design, document and continuously improve processes and internal controls across billing, collections and cash handling, so the work is accurate, auditable, transferable and can be covered
  • Use technology and automation — ERP/CRM, reporting and AI-enabled tooling — to handle growing volume without adding headcount
  • Define, monitor and report on service levels for billing, adjustments and team turnaround, and manage performance against them
  • Partner with the Controller and the wider Finance team on process improvement, reporting and quarterly priorities
  • Carry the finance tasks that require physical presence in the office

Note on team: the day-to-day execution for these areas sits with a Philippines-based team. This role sets the standard and is accountable for the output rather than performing the processing itself.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or a related field
  • Experience: 5–7 years of accounting and financial operations experience, with at least 2 years owning a process area or managing a team
  • Volume: Experience in a high-volume, transaction-intensive environment, with large numbers of invoices, payments and customer accounts
  • Process design and controls: Demonstrated experience designing or improving processes and internal controls
  • Technology: Demonstrated use of technology and automation to improve throughput and accuracy. Strong Excel capability required. Experience with Salesforce, Striven or a comparable CRM/ERP preferred. Familiarity with AI-enabled finance tooling a plus
  • Service management: Experience defining and managing service levels and turnaround standards
  • Offshore teams: Experience working with or managing offshore resources, including daily collaboration across time zones
  • Order-to-cash: Working knowledge of billing, accounts receivable and collections. Experience in a recurring-revenue or service-contract business preferred
  • People leadership: Demonstrated experience managing or developing a team, with accountability for their output
  • Location: This is a fully onsite role based at the Naperville, IL office. It is not available on a remote or hybrid basis. Candidates must be able to commute to Naperville daily
  • Other: Strong written and verbal communication. This role is client- and vendor-facing, and works daily with a team in a different time zone

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience standing up or restructuring a finance process, rather than only running an established one
  • Exposure to PCI-adjacent payment handling and the controls it requires
  • Experience working within an EOS or similar operating framework

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Base Salary: $80,000–$85,000 per year
  • Career Growth: Clear advancement pathways, mentorship, and ongoing training
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, and a collaborative, high-energy culture
  • Meaningful Impact: Help healthcare providers improve compliance and focus on patient care

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
Position Overview

Seeking a highly motivated Service Delivery Manager (SDM) with strong IT support and B2B background. This individual will act as a key bridge between technology, business stakeholders, and service partners, driving stakeholder relationships and robust business partnerships. You will coordinate the remediation of platform concerns, oversee incident management via ServiceNow following ITSM standards, and maintain our IT security posture. The solution-minded candidate will cover the B2B application spectrum across the Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) ecosystem and its integrations with backend enterprise systems like SAP S/4HANA (S/4), managing initiatives across the US, Canada, and Latin America.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Platform Operational Excellence:
  • Ensure the end-to-end service delivery for Americas B2B platforms; oversee the operational impact of seasonal releases and global core updates, assuring regional business continuity and synchronization stability.
  • Service Transition:
  • Facilitate and monitor the project lifecycle of moving new features from "Build" to "Run" (Service Transition) ensuring enhancements, tech debt, and defect fixes transition smoothly from Build to Run with minimal business disruption.
  • Service Management & ITSM: Own and drive end-to-end incident, problem, and change management processes utilizing ServiceNow and adhering strictly to IT Service Management (ITSM) best practices and SLAs.
  • Primary Support Contact: Serve as the primary support contact within the Americas eCommerce Support team for B2B applications, acting as the go-to resource for B2B platform issues and site availability.
  • Platform Expertise (SFCC & S/4): Provide strong technical oversight and hands-on guidance on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) B2B functionalities, alongside managing critical integrations with SAP S/4HANA (S/4) for order management, inventory, and fulfillment.
  • Stakeholder Relationships & Business Partnerships: Cultivate strong partnerships with brand leaders, digital IT teams, and regional business units across the Americas to align support strategies with business goals and ensure transparent communication.
  • Vendor & Delivery Management: Manage external support vendors and internal teams on support and project delivery—including requirement analysis, system design, triage, testing, and deployment. Prioritize support tickets and ensure adherence to KPIs and corporate standards.
  • Triage & Troubleshooting: Assist with the triage and troubleshooting of complex integration and platform processes, ensuring high site uptime and availability of key B2B functions.
  • Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Contribute to internal documentation, share knowledge with teammates, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance support efficiency.


Core Competencies & Professional Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience managing operations and supporting technical platforms and initiatives in a global or regional capacity.
  • Advanced English (mandatory)
  • Strong ITSM experience and a deep working knowledge of ServiceNow for ticket management, incident workflows, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing stakeholder relationships and building business partnerships across varying levels of the organization, bridging the gap between technical teams and business units.
  • Strong IT vendor management expertise.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to break down complex technologies or problems for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience in development and release management, requirement analysis, and technical documentation.
  • Ability to successfully function in a fast-paced dynamic landscape alongside daily operational activities.
  • Bachelor's degree required; people management experience preferred.
  • Self-directed.


Technical Requirements

  • Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) B2B / eCommerce platform / SaaS platform experience.
  • SAP S/4HANA (S/4) knowledge and integration experience, understanding enterprise backend processes (order-to-cash, inventory, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of integration technologies and patterns (REST/SOAP web services, Batch, EDI, SFTP/FTP).
  • Familiarity with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and cross-browser testing.
  • Proficiency in collaboration tools such as GitHub, Confluence, and ServiceNow.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications (Project, PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
  • Passionate about technical support, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

title: Associate Head Tennis Coach
description:
Saint Xavier High School, a Catholic secondary school sponsored by the Xaverian Brothers, has remained faithful to the Xaverian legacy since 1864. With 29 KHSAA Tennis state titles and a tradition of excellence that is unmatched in Kentucky high school tennis, Saint Xavier High School is seeking an Associate Head Tennis Coach to continue the success and development of our tennis program.


The tennis season generally runs from mid-February through May. This position requires availability four per week, typically 3:15 pm-5:30 pm, and Saturdays from 9:00am – 1:00 pm, with additional evening hours for matches and occasional weekend travel for tournaments. The Associate Head Tennis Coach will also participate in fall tennis and winter conditioning programs. This is a stipend position.


Summary

The Associate Head Tennis Coach works closely with the Head Tennis Coach and other members of the coaching staff to support all aspects of the Saint Xavier High School tennis program, including student athlete development, coaching, and continued program success.


Duties & Responsibilities

  • Coach, supervise, and provide instruction to student athletes at all levels of the tennis program.
  • Work with approximately 40 student athletes and evaluate players for correct team placement.
  • Develop practice plans and match lineups for both JV and Varsity teams.
  • Communicate with student athletes, parents, other coaches, and Athletic Administration regarding program activities and expectations.
