title: Senior Manager, Organic & Web Growth
description:
About Arize

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace, so teams can ship faster with confidence.

Arize serves a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like , Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

About Arize AI

Arize AI is an AI observability and evaluation platform helping teams build, evaluate, and improve AI applications and agents. From development through production, Arize gives AI engineering teams the tools to understand how their systems perform, identify failures, and continuously improve their applications.

Our ecosystem includes Arize AX, our managed platform for AI observability and evaluations, and Phoenix, our open-source platform built for AI engineers.

About the Role

We're looking for a technically strong SEO/AEO & Web Growth Manager to help Arize become one of the most visible and trusted platforms in AI engineering.

As developers and enterprise technology buyers increasingly discover products through search engines, AI assistants, technical communities, and third-party resources, we need someone who understands how to build visibility across all of these channels.

This is not a traditional SEO content role.

We're looking for someone who understands the technical foundations of search, can diagnose and resolve website performance issues, and knows how to build organic authority in a highly competitive market.

You'll own the technical and analytical work behind growing Arize's presence in Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other relevant discovery experiences.

You'll also play a central role in improving how our website performs, from search visibility and page experience to conversion optimization and measurement.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You'll partner closely with Content, Product Marketing, Marketing Engineering, and external technical resources to turn organic growth opportunities into measurable results.

What You'll Do

Own technical SEO performance

  • Develop and execute Arize's technical SEO roadmap.
  • Audit and improve crawlability, indexability, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, and site architecture.
  • Optimize internal linking, structured data, page performance, and technical search foundations.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical SEO issues, including those associated with website migrations and content restructuring.
  • Partner with web developers to implement improvements, validate releases, and prevent regressions.
  • Monitor technical site health and proactively identify issues affecting discoverability.

Build Arize's AEO and AI search strategy

  • Establish a measurable framework for Arize's visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI search experiences, and other relevant AI discovery platforms.
  • Analyze how AI assistants recommend, mention, and cite Arize relative to competitors.
  • Identify the content, sources, technical issues, and authority signals contributing to competitive visibility gaps.
  • Develop strategies to increase Arize's presence in relevant AI-generated answers.
  • Partner with Content, PMM, DevRel, and ecosystem partners to improve authoritative third-party coverage and citations.
  • Test emerging optimization approaches and distinguish measurable improvements from unproven tactics.

Drive organic acquisition and competitive growth

  • Conduct competitive search and content-gap analyses across AI observability, agent evaluation, and adjacent categories.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value nonbrand search opportunities based on audience intent and commercial potential.
  • Develop clear briefs and optimization recommendations for Content and Product Marketing.
  • Build an off-page authority strategy focused on relevant backlinks, technical publications, industry resources, and earned mentions.
  • Identify opportunities to turn existing unlinked mentions, partnerships, and community contributions into relevant referring links.
  • Improve existing content performance through technical optimization, internal linking, consolidation, and targeted refreshes.

Own website growth and optimization

  • Partner with Marketing Engineering and web development resources to improve website functionality, performance, and conversion.
  • Identify technical and UX friction across key visitor journeys.
  • Develop and prioritize a website experimentation roadmap focused on qualified traffic, demo requests, and self-serve signups.
  • Implement or coordinate landing page tests, conversion improvements, and performance enhancements.
  • Ensure appropriate analytics and event tracking are in place to measure organic acquisition and conversion.
  • Build scalable processes for technical website updates, testing, and performance monitoring.

Build a data-driven organic growth program

  • Own reporting for organic visibility, search performance, AI citations, qualified acquisition, and website conversion.
  • Use Google Search Console, GA4, crawling tools, SEO platforms, and other analytics systems to identify opportunities.
  • Establish competitive benchmarks and performance reporting across traditional and AI search.
  • Partner with Growth and Marketing Operations to connect organic performance with signup, demo, and pipeline outcomes.
  • Manage and evaluate specialist agencies and contractors, with a focus on measurable execution and technical quality.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of hands-on SEO and organic growth experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, developer tooling, infrastructure, or another technical market.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO, including indexing, crawling, rendering, redirects, canonical tags, structured data, and site architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience improving organic visibility and qualified traffic in competitive search categories.
  • Practical experience investigating or optimizing visibility in AI search and answer engines.
  • Strong understanding of website development fundamentals, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, rendering, and web performance.
  • Ability to work directly with developers, diagnose technical problems, and write detailed implementation requirements.
  • Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Semrush, or comparable platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion optimization, experimentation, and website analytics.
  • Experience developing backlink acquisition or digital PR strategies focused on relevant, high-quality referring domains.
  • Strong analytical skills and an ability to prioritize based on business impact.
  • Comfortable operating independently and personally doing the technical work rather than relying exclusively on agencies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with developer tools, AI infrastructure, observability, or open-source products.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, and AI engineering workflows.
  • Working knowledge of SQL or Python for search and website performance analysis.
  • Experience with web analytics instrumentation, tag management, and experimentation tools.
  • Experience working with modern web frameworks, static site generators, and technical documentation sites.
  • Experience improving both enterprise demo conversion and self-serve signup journeys.
  • Experience managing technical SEO through a website migration or major information architecture change.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you'll have:

  • Established clear technical SEO priorities and measurably improved website search health.
  • Increased Arize's visibility across high-value nonbrand search categories.
  • Built a repeatable measurement and experimentation program for AI-answer visibility.
  • Increased relevant third-party references, mentions, and backlinks.
  • Improved organic acquisition of qualified website visitors.
  • Increased organic contribution to AX signups and enterprise demo requests.
  • Built a reliable technical website optimization process with Marketing and Engineering.
  • Created a performance dashboard connecting organic visibility to measurable business outcomes.

The estimated annual salary for this role is between $160,000 to $190,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes a comprehensive benefit package, including: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.

More About Arize

Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

Learn more about what we're doing here:

Diversity & Inclusion @ Arize

Our company's mission is to make AI work and make AI work for the people, we hope to make an impact in bias industry-wide and that's a big motivator for people who work here. We actively hope that individuals contribute to a good culture

  • Regularly have chats with industry experts, researchers, and ethicists across the ecosystem to advance the use of responsible AI
  • Culturally conscious events such as LGBTQ trivia during pride month
  • We have an active Lady Arizers subgroup

title: AWS Data Engineer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking Engineers to join our On-Premises to AWS S3 Migration Platform team — a high-visibility program that designs, builds, and operates a secure, scalable migration platform to move object storage data from on-premises, S3-compatible object storage to AWS S3.

Responsibilities of the Engineer include:

  1. Migration Workflow Ownership & Orchestration

1. Own the end-to-end migration workflow from on-premises source buckets to AWS S3 destination buckets, covering manifest-based and non-manifest migration paths.

2. Build and operate AWS-based orchestration using Step Functions, Lambda, Fargate, AWS Batch, DynamoDB, SQS, and rclone.

3. Implement batching, sharding, task sizing, and retry handling based on documented compute-tier thresholds (DC node, Bare Metal, manifest-required).

4. Support express-route (like-for-like) vs. exception-route migrations, using data-detectable criteria to auto-classify buckets where possible.

  1. Execution & Validation
  2. Automate pre-flight dry-run validation (credentials, connectivity, readability/writability, size/object-count limits) as a gate before any real transfer.
  3. Implement and verify source freeze — apply deny-write policy centrally and confirm enforcement via synthetic write-attempt checks.
  4. Operate the rclone-based migration runtime with correct credential handling (Kerberos keytab, IAM role assumption via STS), KMS-encrypted destinations, and manifest generation for large migrations.
  5. Build and run post-migration reconciliation checks comparing source and destination — object count/size match, per-object checksum match, drift detection, version completeness, and configuration parity.
  6. Track and enforce the point-of-no-return cutover step — owner written acknowledgment, followed by centrally sealing the source against reads and writes.
  7. Governance, Observability & Reporting
  8. Implement governance for bandwidth allocation, queue management, prioritisation, throttling, and job tracking across concurrent migrations.
  9. Design DynamoDB-backed job, task, queue, bandwidth, and summary state tracking.
  10. Build CloudWatch dashboards, logs, metrics, alerts, and health checks; parse migration logs into structured pass/fail evidence.
  11. Track migration progress, escalations, and blockers via Jira; measure success on namespaces closed, not petabytes moved. Produce structured reports and dashboards for stakeholders and senior leadership.
  12. Process Improvement & Automation
  13. Rigor & Follow-Through: Proactively follow up on outstanding freeze/owner sign-offs; escalate delays per SLA with clear professional communication.
  14. Automation-First: Continuously convert manual verification steps (dry-run review, log inspection, reconciliation) into automated, repeatable gate checks to increase migration throughput.
  15. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Cloud Platform, Storage Engineering, and Networking teams to resolve connectivity and platform issues; adapt quickly to new tooling as the platform matures.

Technical Skills:

  1. Basic Qualifications
  2. Education: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  3. Experience: 3–5 years of professional experience in infrastructure engineering, cloud migration, or large-scale enterprise data platform delivery.
  4. Languages: Strong Python (boto3, JSON processing, exception handling, logging, dataclasses, streaming files, API integration); Unix/Linux Shell Scripting.
  5. Methodology: Familiarity with change management processes in regulated financial industries.
  6. Core Infrastructure Competencies: Candidates must demonstrate a solid understanding of the following:

1. Object Storage & S3-Compatible APIs: Deep understanding of Amazon S3, S3 Intelligent-Tiering, S3-compatible APIs (e.g., Dell ECS or similar platforms), object metadata, prefix structures, large object transfers, versioning, and lifecycle policies.

2. Migration Tooling (rclone): Hands-on experience configuring and operating rclone for high-volume transfers — copy vs. sync behaviour, checksums, checkers, retries, no-traverse behaviour, stats, logs, and bandwidth limiting.

3. AWS Serverless & Compute: Hands-on experience with Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, API Gateway, SSM Parameter Store, Secrets Manager, ECS Fargate, and AWS Batch.

4. DynamoDB: Ability to design and operate tables, keys, indexes, scans, updates, batch writes, Decimal handling, and state-management patterns for job/task tracking.

5. Networking: Understanding of AWS Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPCs, private subnets, S3 Gateway Endpoints, NAT Gateway scoping, and high-throughput network design for migration traffic.

6. IAM & Security: Strong knowledge of IAM roles, cross-account access, STS assume-role, Kerberos keytab auth, Secrets Manager, KMS encryption, and least-privilege design.

7. Development Environments: Working knowledge of IDEs such as VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA, and PyCharm.

8. AI & Automation Tools: Familiarity with AI engines and assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) to accelerate scripting, validation logic, and reporting.

Core Competencies:

  1. Acts as a trusted team player who collaborates effectively across multiple teams and functions.
  2. Communicates with clarity and confidence — concise written updates, structured verbal briefings, and proactive stakeholder management.
  3. Works effectively with global teams across time zones and cultures; builds alignment and resolves issues constructively.
  4. Delivery-focused with a strong sense of ownership; drives work to closure and meets commitments.
  5. Brings high energy and urgency to achieve targets while maintaining quality and professionalism.
  6. Shows intellectual curiosity; asks thoughtful questions, surfaces risks early, and seeks feedback to continuously improve.

  • Tiempo de experiencia 5 años
  • Estudios Universitarios - no titulado

Competencias clave para el puesto

  • Python
  • Amazon DynamoDB
  • Inglés - Avanzado

title: Crane Operations Trainer
description:
Are you a highly organized, dependable professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and training people? SEI is looking for a Cranes Operations Trainer to support our branches operations by delivering crane operator, signalperson, rigger, and related safety training through classroom instruction, hands-on practical training, and sample exercises.


As a key member of our CCO team, the Crane Operations Trainer instructs participants on safe crane operation, load chart application, rigging practices, signaling, jobsite hazard awareness, equipment setup, and exam-specific performance expectations in preparation for written and practical exam administration.


As a Crane Inspector, this role is also responsible for performing mobile, articulating, and self-erecting tower crane and other related equipment inspections per the applicable standards.


Who We Are

Stephenson Equipment, Inc. has been an industry leader in Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, D.C., and Virginia since 1957, providing sales, rentals, parts, and service for construction equipment, cranes, paving, road building, and road maintenance equipment.


What You'll Do

Training Delivery and Classroom Instruction

  • Deliver crane operator, signalperson, rigger, and related safety training using approved classroom materials, participant discussion, demonstrations, and practical examples.
  • Teach crane safety standards, OSHA and industry requirements, jobsite hazard awareness, crane setup considerations, load chart usage, rigging principles, signaling, lift planning concepts, and safe operating practices.
  • Prepare participants for written certification requirements by clearly explaining technical concepts and reinforcing key exam content through review, examples, and knowledge checks.

Hands-On Training and Practice Exams

  • Provide hands-on crane operator training for new, developing, and semi-experienced operators to build safe operating skills, confidence, and jobsite readiness.
  • Conduct hands-on practical exercises and field-based training activities that mirror practical exam expectations and reinforce proper crane operation techniques.
  • Observe participant performance during hands-on activities, identify skill gaps, provide coaching, and give constructive feedback to improve safety, accuracy, control, and confidence.

Practical Exam Administration and Site Coordination

  • Administer CCO practical exams in accordance with applicable testing procedures, examiner requirements, and certification standards.
  • Lay out, measure, and set up practical exam courses and practice areas using required tools, course materials, and equipment.
  • Coordinate crane availability, equipment setup, course layout, candidate flow, and test-site readiness for practical exams and practice activities.
  • Serve as practical exam test site coordinator when needed and ensure exam areas are safe, organized, properly prepared, and compliant with applicable requirements.

Training Materials, Safety, and Continuous Improvement

title: SOC Analyst Jr (Palo Alto)
description:
At TD SYNNEX, we are looking for a SOC Analyst Jr. (Palo Alto) to provide Level 1 technical support for enterprise network security environments, primarily focused on Palo Alto Networks technologies.

This role is responsible for diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents related to firewalls, VPNs, secure connectivity, and network security services while delivering an exceptional customer experience. This is an excellent opportunity for professionals looking to grow their careers in Cybersecurity, working with industry-leading technologies and supporting U.S.-based customers.


Responsabilities:

  • Provide Level 1 technical support for network security solutions and enterprise firewall environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to firewall configurations, security policies, and network connectivity.
  • Support VPN technologies, secure remote access solutions, and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Manage technical incidents and service requests through ticketing systems, email, and remote support sessions.
  • Assist customers with security-related configuration changes, including access restrictions, website blocking, and firewall policy updates.
  • Escalate complex incidents to higher-level support teams when required.
  • Utilize internal knowledge bases, technical documentation, and vendor resources to resolve customer issues.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, root causes, and resolutions according to established processes.
  • Maintain professional and effective communication with customers in English.



?Knowledge, Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Telecommunications, or a related field.
  • 1 to 2 years of experience in Technical Support, Network Support, NOC/SOC Analyst or Infrastructure Support roles.
  • Advanced or fluent English (required).
  • Hands-on experience supporting or administering enterprise firewall solutions.
  • Experience with Palo Alto Networks is highly preferred; experience with Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco, SonicWall, or similar technologies will also be considered.


  • Basic knowledge of:
  • Firewall policies and security rules.
  • VPN technologies (Site-to-Site and Remote Access VPN).
  • Network connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Network security fundamentals and secure access controls.
  • TCP/IP, DNS, routing, and networking concepts.


  • Experience working with incident management and ticketing systems.
  • Ability to confidently engage in technical conversations with U.S.-based customers.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and customer service skills.
  • Cybersecurity or networking certifications are a plus.

title: Maintenance and Facilities
description:
Ministerial Character

As beloved sons and daughters of God, we, the parish of Saint William, are called to proclaim, by word and deed, the Gospel of Jesus Christ, crucified and risen. By the guidance of the Holy Spirit and the grace of the Sacraments, we endeavor to lead all souls to heaven by fostering spiritual healing and equipping all people for the work of ministry.


The Pastor is the visible principle and foundation of unity in the parish of Saint William Catholic Church which the Bishop has entrusted to him. He makes Christ’s mission present and enduring in the parish. To fulfill his mission, the Pastor employs suitable, chosen collaborators (clerics, religious, or laypeople). He shares with them his mission and entrusts various responsibilities to them.


Positions employed at Saint William help to extend the ministry of the Pastor in particular ways as outlined in the job description. Therefore, the employee in this position is closely connected to and assists the Pastor in performing his ministry, thereby engaging in ministry for the Church.


Job Summary:

This person will join a strong team that is dedicated to the day-to-day upkeeping, cleaning, set-ups, repairs, and maintenance needs of the campus that comes with a busy parish.

Essential Job Duties:

Under general supervision:

  • As an integral part of your ministry for the Church as carried out in this position, support and uphold the philosophy of Catholic ministry and the mission of the parish in both your professional and personal life.
  • Act as a witness to Gospel values by modeling the teachings of the Roman Catholic Church.
  • Maintains the campus custodial operations.
  • Follows routine cleaning and maintenance procedures to ensure high safety, cleanliness, and efficiency of building operations and grounds.
  • Perform routine maintenance tasks such as changing light bulbs, cleaning ceiling diffusers and grilles, changing out air filters, painting and drywall repairs, carpet cleaning, floor refinishing, landscaping, sprinkler system, and other facilities needs.
  • Perform specialized custodial care of buildings and grounds.
  • · Unlock or open buildings and classroom doors and Lock or close buildings as rested.
  • · Responsible for the day-to-day physical operations of the Church facilities including but not limited to setting up tables, chairs, AV equipment, and garbage bins, preparing beverages, doing inventory control of maintenance supplies, and creating a pleasing atmosphere for visitors, parishioners, and staff.
  • Support the Pastor, clergy, staff, and membership of St. William by professionally responding to their needs. Must have the ability to take direction from multiple sources and work alone at times without supervision.
  • Must maintain a professional appearance and attitude while on campus and among all staff as well as provide a welcoming and courteous environment.
  • Support the parish by completing work orders and supporting all aspects of events and campus cleanliness.
  • Must have a servant leadership work ethic (Serving the needs of others) and teamwork attitude with a willingness to fill in wherever needed.
  • Perform basic audio and video equipment functions.
  • Perform specialized custodial care of buildings and grounds.
  • Perform classroom and meeting space set-ups of tables, chairs, and peripherals.
  • Assists in the setup, teardown, and cleaning of all parish events.
  • Assists with the moving of furniture and equipment as directed by the Director of Facilities and supervisor (Shift-Lead).
  • Assists in maintaining the neatness and cleanliness of grounds, including sidewalks, driveways, parking lot, sports facilities, and grounds.
  • Follow work orders and supervisor direction.
  • Assists the Director of Facilities and supervisors (Shift lead) with any other necessary jobs and duties as assigned.
  • Work weekends and holidays (especially Christmas and Holy Week).
  • Work different shifts as needed.
  • 30 minutes of prayer time.
  • All duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of the structure and basic teachings of the Roman Catholic Church
  • Knowledge of general cleaning practices with household-type chemicals and equipment.
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service and work effectively with staff, clergy, and laity.
  • Ability to read labels, use cleaning chemicals safely, follow safety protocols, wear safety gear, and use the appropriate tools for each task.
  • Basic understanding of email, and mobile apps (e-space, Openpath, Entouch, etc.).
  • Maintain confidentiality at all times.
  • Ability to work independently at a fast pace, pay attention to detail, and perform repetitive jobs.
  • Ability to lift and carry at least 40 pounds.
  • Ability to proficiently communicate in English.
